fact_sheet: The reverse proxy terminates the client TLS connection.
The proxy sends a new HTTP request to the upstream service.
X-Forwarded-For can preserve the client IP chain.
The upstream service must not assume the TCP peer IP is the original client IP.

questions.question: 哪个组件终止客户端 TLS 连接？
为什么上游服务不能只依赖 TCP peer IP 判断原始客户端？
questions.answer: 因为 TCP 连接来自反向代理，而不是原始客户端。
